summary: Iteration 22 — FINAL PRE-LAUNCH CLICK-BY-CLICK AUDIT across all 4 personas (super_admin, reseller, hr_admin, employee). Logged in as each, walked every accessible sidebar entry (60+ routes visited end-to-end), and clicked every primary CTA / row action to verify it actually DOES something (opens modal, triggers API, or navigates). 50+ pages render with 0 console errors; however, SEVEN non-functional buttons / missing CTAs and ONE permission leak were found that are launch-blockers, plus three medium-severity gaps.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Company scope required' when called by super_admin (who has no tenant). UI handles it gracefully with a 'Company scope required' empty state, but the 400 pollutes console/network. Recommend: return 200 with empty payload + scope_required:true flag, or don't fire the request when tenantId is null.
Returns 403 twice to employee persona on /app/posh mount. Page still renders. Either suppress the fetch for non-committee roles or have the endpoint return 200 with committee:null.

ui_bugs.issue: No 'Add employee' CTA visible to HR admin on /app/employees. Feature listed in test plan and core HR workflow but UI button is absent. HR admin cannot create a single employee from directory (only bulk-import route available).
ui_bugs.expected: An 'Add employee' button that opens a create-employee modal

ui_bugs.expected: Open a 'Generate letter' modal → choose employee → preview/download PDF

ui_bugs.issue: Primary CTA 'Check in visitor' click produces no modal, no API call, no navigation. Button is dead.
ui_bugs.expected: Open a modal to register / check in visitor

ui_bugs.issue: Primary CTA 'New booking' click produces no modal, no API call, no navigation. Button is dead.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a company row (e.g. 'ACME Global') on /app/companies does NOTHING — no detail page navigation, no drawer, no modal. Same problem for reseller rows on /app/resellers.
ui_bugs.expected: Navigate to /app/companies/:id (or open side-drawer) showing tenant detail

ui_bugs.issue: Visiting an authenticated user to /app/this-does-not-exist renders the PUBLIC marketing Landing page (hero 'The HRMS built for the multi-country enterprise'). Breaks the app shell and confuses the signed-in user.
ui_bugs.expected: Show a friendly 404 inside the app shell with a 'Back to dashboard' link, OR redirect to role-appropriate landing

ui_bugs.issue: Employee persona on /app/expenses sees 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons on the claims list (visible in sidebar scan). Employees must never see admin actions. Permission leak.
ui_bugs.expected: Hide approve/reject for role != manager/company_admin; show only 'New claim' + own rows with 'Voucher PDF' for approved

ui_bugs.issue: Super admin sidebar only exposes 5 entries (Platform, Resellers, Companies, Modules, Help). Routes that are role=super_admin in moduleRegistry (employment-classes, audit-log, bulk-import, employees directory) are NOT reachable from the SA sidebar — user must type the URL manually.
ui_bugs.expected: Either add these entries to ROLE_WORKSPACES.super_admin, or expose a 'Tenant tools' section when SA impersonates a company

ui_bugs.issue: Reseller sidebar only shows Overview + My Companies + Help. The user request explicitly asked to verify 'commissions / billing / pricing' buttons — these pages/buttons do NOT exist for reseller persona. Either flag as 'coming soon' or build before launch.
ui_bugs.expected: Add commission/billing/pricing navigation or document these as post-launch features

critical_code_review_comments: Multiple primary CTAs across Letters, Visitors and ResourceBooking are rendered without onClick handlers — a lint rule (or simple grep for '<button' lacking onClick) would have caught these.

Super-admin role gets role-allowlisted nav items defined in MODULES (roles:['super_admin','company_admin']) but those MODULES are never shown because SA uses ROLE_WORKSPACES (mini workspace) — the two nav systems contradict each other.
Router likely has no catch-all route; /app/* currently falls through to the public Landing component, bypassing the authenticated layout.
Employee expenses page appears to render approve/reject actions based on row.status ('submitted') without a role check — add a role guard before rendering admin actions.

Both employment-class/stats and employment-class/config endpoints should accept super_admin requests with no tenant header and return an empty payload (200) instead of a 400; otherwise UIs must feature-flag the fetch.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (50+ pages render clean; 7 HIGH button/flow defects + 2 MED gaps across 4 personas)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created — this run only enumerates existing UI; modals were opened then closed via Esc without submitting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scope covered: login flow ✓ for all 4 roles; 60+ routes walked; primary CTAs clicked to verify modal/API/navigation. Scope NOT fully covered due to scale: (a) end-to-end submission of each modal form (e.g. actually saving a new branch/budget/ticket etc — I confirmed the modal opens, not that save persists — recommend next agent to test the top 5 create-flows end-to-end), (b) row-level edit/delete buttons on every list, (c) mobile viewport responsiveness, (d) manager@acme.io persona sidebar walk, (e) module-switcher between workspaces. The 4 newest pages (CompOff, InvestmentDeclarations, BulkEmployeeImport, AuditLog) confirmed rendering with no console errors as in iteration 21.
rca of the issue: The 7 HIGH bugs group into three categories: (1) missing onClick handlers on primary CTAs (Letters-Generate, Visitors-CheckIn, ResourceBooking-NewBooking) — classic 'button rendered, handler forgotten'; (2) missing row-click navigation (Companies/Resellers list rows have no Link/onClick wrapper) — likely the developer expected a separate detail page that never got wired to the router; (3) missing role guards (Employee seeing Approve/Reject) + missing catch-all 404 route — both router/permission plumbing gaps. All are fixable in under a day before launch.
